item.title: Sharp rise reported in local house prices
item.description: House prices across the Shannonside region have seen a sharp rise in the last three months of this year. That's according to the Irish Independent REA Average House Price Index. The report focuses on the average price of a three-bed semi-detached home. Advertisement Prices in Longford have risen by 3.3 per cent to €221,000. item.description: A local hospital is the most overcrowded hospital in the country today. item.title: Long-standing tidy towns volunteer retires
item.description: One of the country's longest serving tidytowns volunteers has retired after over 50 years. Pat Garvey started working with Ballintubber Tidy Towns in county Roscommon in 1974. But he has decided to quit at the age of 86. Advertisement Another of the group's long-serving members, Eileen Kenny, stepped down in November after a similar term.

item.title: Ciaran Frawley to join Connacht next season
item.description: Ciarán Frawley will join Connacht from Leinster Rugby on a two-year deal, ahead of the 2026/27 season. Frawley joins Connacht with a wealth of experience at the very highest level. The 28-year old made his senior Ireland debut against Italy in August 2023. Whereas, Frawley has made over 100 appearances for Leinster since 2018 scoring over 300 points.
